name: Falrin remembers an old friend

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Dungeon Set 2 questline

summary: In Dire Maul’s Athenaeum, Anthion’s old friend Falrin Treeshaper listens to the request. He had thought Anthion dead. Falrin agrees to help prepare an enchantment that can draw Theldren into a fight; his anger at the ogres is personal, rooted in the death of his brother. The required collection is a task in play, not a separate historical episode. What matters to the story is that an old bond supplies the means for a dangerous meeting.
